note: The Pitcairn Islands: every visitor staying up to 14 days needs no visa or prior clearance and gets permission to land on arrival; longer, working or business visits need entry clearance applied for 3 months ahead (not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy (the territory's immigration pages publish no list this client can read).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policies of British Overseas Territories
sources.said: Pitcairn Islands – Visitors intending to stay for up to 14 days do not need a visa or prior clearance, and may obtain permission to enter on arrival.
